async def act(page):
    # Navigate to the admin dashboard
    await page.goto("/index.php/admin")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Now navigate to the product reviews page
    await page.goto("/index.php/admin/review/product/")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Find the count of Approved reviews
    import re
    approved_elements = page.get_by_text("Approved", exact=False)
    count = None
    element_count = await approved_elements.count()
    for i in range(element_count):
        text = await approved_elements.nth(i).text_content()
        match = re.search(r'\b(\d+)\b', text)
        if match:
            count = match.group(1)
            break
    if count is not None:
        print(count)
    else:
        # If no count found, print the page content for debugging
        content = await page.content()
        print(content[:1000])
